mapper.sql: c.id, c.class_term, c.campus_id, cp.campus_name, c.head_teacher_id, ifnull(nullif(u.real_name, ''), ifnull(nullif(u.nickname, ''), u.username)) as head_teacher_name, c.class_status, c.start_time, c.course_id, crs.course_name, c.student_count, exists(select 1 from edu_class_schedule s where s.class_id = c.id) as has_schedule, c.created_at, c.updated_at
mapper.insert: insert into edu_class (class_term, campus_id, head_teacher_id, class_status, start_time, course_id, student_count, created_at, updated_at) values (#{classTerm}, #{campusId}, #{headTeacherId}, #{classStatus}, #{startTime}, #{courseId}, #{studentCount}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: update edu_class set class_term = #{classTerm}, campus_id = #{campusId}, head_teacher_id = #{headTeacherId}, class_status = #{classStatus}, start_time = #{startTime}, course_id = #{courseId}, student_count = #{studentCount}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select from edu_class c left join edu_campus cp on cp.id = c.campus_id left join sys_user u on u.id = c.head_teacher_id left join edu_course crs on crs.id = c.course_id where c.id = #{id}
